user.title: Connect an MQTT bridge
user.description: Use the same bridge ID configured in the Freetz package.

reconfigure.title: Configure bridge
reconfigure.description: The FRITZ!Box URL opens the Smart Home interface used to assign virtual devices to the 440.

mqtt_confirm.title: Add discovered bridge
mqtt_confirm.description: Connect the discovered FRITZ! Virtual Bridge {bridge_id}.

error.invalid_bridge_id: Use 3–32 lowercase letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens.
error.invalid_fritz_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS URL without credentials, query parameters or fragments.

abort.invalid_discovery: The MQTT bridge announcement is invalid or unsupported.

user.title: Add virtual device
user.description: Choose the Home Assistant entity that the 440 should control.

details.title: Confirm virtual device
details.description: The closest profile is selected automatically. FRITZ!OS remains responsible for assigning the device to a 440 screen position.

reconfigure.title: Rebind virtual device
reconfigure.description: Changing the source entity or name keeps the FRITZ identity and existing 440 assignments.

error.already_mapped: This Home Assistant entity already has a virtual FRITZ device on this bridge.
error.incompatible_profile: The entity does not support this persistent FRITZ profile.
error.invalid_name: Enter a name without leading or trailing spaces and containing at most 79 UTF-8 bytes.
error.source_entity_missing: The selected Home Assistant entity does not exist.

abort.source_entity_missing: The selected Home Assistant entity no longer exists.
